Ice Cube Has Accomplished A Lot Throughout His Career And Now He Can Add Starring In The Worst Movie Ever
Ice Cube and Eva Longoria headline a new sci-fi thriller film, War of the Worlds, now streaming on Amazon Prime Video, but the response has been anything but stellar.
Critics are slamming the alien-invasion movie, earning it a rare 0% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, while audiences have only been slightly more forgiving, giving it a dismal 14%.
Many movie goers claim that this movie is one of the most WOKE product placement filled films to ever be created and even going as far to claim that this entire movie was created to promote Amazon.
The complaints might appear to drastic until one watches this film, it is undoubtedly the worst depiction of the HG Wells classic.
